title: Should I use Continue.dev with Ollama + qwen2.5-coder:1.5b or Claude Code + Ollama ?
author: Hot_Cause8918
selftext:
I have 2 tutorials here that im about to follow:

  
1. Ollama + qwen2.5-coder:1.5b, though its been a year so maybe its outdated:

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7AImkA96mE8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7AImkA96mE8)

2. And this is Ollama + Claude Code:  
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3x2q6-5XbQ8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3x2q6-5XbQ8)

Which system is the best it seems option 1, is more reliable but option 2 is more recent.

Any other free option that could be better?

comments.author: AgenticGameDev
comments.body:
Why ollama? What is the usecase? Why not coderabbit?
Oh well looking forward to see what other mentions in this thread.

replies.author: Hot_Cause8918
replies.body:
Its for a JS game. Didnt try CodeRabbit. How is it?

From my quick research after you suggestion, it seems it doesnt do multifile changes, does not create classes or files.

Thats something im being able to do with Ollama + qwen2.5-coder:1.5b so far.

Though so far it seems its demanding a lot from my pc, and it was a pain to install it (a bunch of extensions) etc...

I need to try Codeium too.

Did you try any of these 2? Codeium or Ollama ?

replies.author: AgenticGameDev
replies.body: I just use Claude Code and write pure test code. Unit test, play mode tests and E2E tests… so not any ai magic on test side. All super stable. But this is a different usecase more of ai review. I do that manually by spinning up teams to do larger code reviews. Rather than reviewing specific changes.
